_note: THE app settings, written by the admin dashboard (admin.html -> Download settings.json). js/coins.js reads it (a copy saved by the dashboard on this device wins). Design: docs/coins-and-admin.md. items = the admin's own state per subject / unit / lesson (open | soon | locked, optional coins); ids: s:<subject>, u:<subject>:<unit>, l:<subject>-<folder>.

coins.shareText: تطبيق EasyStudy للمذاكرة بالألعاب لأولادنا في الصف الأول الابتدائي، جربوه:

referral._note: needs the server (api): coins to the sharer when a NEW parent registers from their link, ON TOP of the coins for each share (Marwa 2026-11-05: we want more shares)

coins._marwa: 2026-11-05: sign-up gift 5 coins; personal shares 3 (WhatsApp, Messenger, own Facebook profile), groups 5 (WhatsApp / Facebook groups)
coins._shareCheck: Marwa 2026-11-05: credits only when the app really leaves after the share tap (WhatsApp/Facebook opened) and comes back after at least shareMinSec seconds

free._marwa: 2026-11-05: the child picks ONE free lesson in each subject
free._modes: first = first <count> lessons of every subject; firstUnit = first <count> units of every subject; pick = the child picks <count> lessons anywhere; pickUnit = the child picks <count> whole units; list = only the lessons / units in list

_api: the server address, e.g. "/api" once the Worker is live; empty = everything stays on this device
